I can’t say enough wonderful things about Carlie at Pet Supplies Plus! She has been grooming my German Shepherd, Bleu, since she was 4 months old she’s now about a year and a half.

Bleu is a large, very reactive and anxious dog, so trusting someone with her is a big deal for me. From day one, Carlie has shown incredible patience, gentleness, confidence, and genuine care. She has taken the time to understand Bleu’s triggers, respect her boundaries, and make every visit as calm and comfortable as possible.

What I appreciate most is that Carlie never makes Bleu feel like she is “too much.” She meets her exactly where she is every single time, and that means everything to me as a dog mom.

At this point, Carlie isn’t just Bleu’s groomer she feels like family. Bleu trusts her, I trust her, and I’m so grateful we found her.

If you have a large, anxious, or reactive pup, I highly recommend Carlie. She is truly special, and Pet Supplies Plus is lucky to have her!

This isn't a bad store overall, but it is definitely on the smaller side compared to other locations. I stopped by specifically to pick up some cat supplies, and unfortunately, the selection was pretty limited. The cat section was much smaller than I expected, and they didn't have several of the items I was looking for. I ended up having to visit another location to find everything I needed.

That being said, the staff made a positive impression. Everyone I interacted with was very friendly, welcoming, and willing to help. They were polite and provided good customer service, which I always appreciate when shopping. The store itself was clean and organized, making it easy to browse what they did have in stock.

My biggest issue was simply the lack of variety for cat owners. While there seemed to be a decent selection for other pets, the cat section felt overlooked and understocked. If you're shopping for basic cat supplies, you may find what you need, but if you're looking for a specific brand, food, toy, or accessory, you might have better luck at a larger location.

Overall, it's a decent store with great staff, but not the best option if you're looking for a wide selection of cat products.

I went into the store today to buy a cat cage because I was driving home (three hours away), and my cat had thrown up on his original carrier. I left my cat in the car and ran into the store—already having a HORRIBLE day. When I went to check out, the cashier recognized me because I had called earlier to check if they had any in stock.

After I paid, I realized the cage needed to be assembled (literally just adding screws), but I’d never done it before, and my cat was still waiting in the car. The cashier offered to help me build it, and honestly, I was so stressed and overwhelmed at that moment from personal issues, I was on the verge of an anxiety attack, but her kindness and patience made such a difference.

While she helped me, we talked, and she asked about my cat in the sweetest way. It felt like she genuinely cared and that helped me calm down. She didn’t have to help me, but she went above and beyond, and I can’t thank her enough for that.

I know this might seem like such a small thing, but it truly made my day, and I’m so thankful. She is an amazing worker, and her kindness completely turned things around for me.
